sourceFacts: Hetu Technology government-affairs manager transferred from the Pearl River Delta
suit is cut half an inch looser than local peers to retain an outsider identity
always carries throat lozenges because he communicates with officials every day
designAssumptions: short neatly side-parted brown hair and brown eyes
slightly loose dark-blue business suit, pale-blue dress shirt and black necktie
one unmarked lozenge in hand rather than a branded box
sceneConcept: A polished thirty-nine-year-old Chinese government-affairs manager stands alone against a transparent background. His dark-blue business suit is subtly looser than local convention over a pale-blue dress shirt and black tie. He presents one small unmarked throat lozenge in one hand while the other hand remains open in a practiced diplomatic gesture, with a warm but careful smile under soft even frontal light.
naturalLanguageDetail: A polished thirty-nine-year-old Chinese government-affairs manager offers a single small unmarked throat lozenge while maintaining an open diplomatic gesture, under soft even frontal studio light without branded packaging, writing or a bright rim.
